title: Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-2)
about: Two-question depression screen, scored 0 to 6. A score of 3 or more is the usual point to give the PHQ-9.

source.name: PHQ-2, the PHQ-9's first two questions (Kroenke, Spitzer and Williams)

blocks.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
items: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

blocks.text: A total of 3 or more is the usual cut-off for giving the full PHQ-9.
